title: phyllanthus myrtilloides subsp. erythrinus
intro: Phyllanthus myrtilloides subsp. erythrinus, commonly known as the Erythrinan Phyllanthus, is a plant species belonging to the Phyllanthus genus and Euphorbiaceae family. It is a shrub native to tropical Africa and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Phyllanthus myrtilloides subsp. erythrinus include its potential to protect against liver and kidney damage, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its anti-hepatotoxic and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
